view.zoomIn.tip: Zoom in (wheel over the diagram also works)

chat.hintStart: Enter instructions to start an AI session
chat.hintStartAgent: Enter instructions to start a {agent} session
repoask.switch.tip: Switch the chat's repo/cwd to the candidate and resend the held request there
repoask.keep.tip: Resend with the current repo (this chat will not ask about this candidate again)
repoask.text: This looks intended for {slug}{reason}. Current repo: {repo} — switch?
input.placeholder: Enter instructions (Enter to send / Shift+Enter for newline / extra instructions while running also OK)
input.hint: Attachments can be pasted or picked. Sending while running adds a steer instruction. The last send can be revised with ↑ or ✎.
input.reviseHint: Revise mode: sending undoes the previous send and retries (Esc to cancel)
exmode.tip: Processing mode: direct=sequential as before / parallel=split the issue and auto-start child chats for deeper per-chat work
head.newChat.tip: Start a new chat (cwd = current repo path)
dirpick.title: Select folder
ctx.label: context
plink.child.tip: Child chat of a split task

Restore to which point? (enter a number / blank = latest only)

board.rework.tip: Send a rework prompt and move back to In progress (POST /api/chat/rework)
board.needsHuman.tip: Send-back limit reached — human decision required
board.reworkWait.tip: Verify-NG send-back prompt held (send via Resume all or Send back)
board.closeAll.tip: Delete all chats in the Done column
board.closeAll.confirm: Delete all {count} chats in the Done column?
board.resume.tip: Reconnect via session/load (no need to wait for the next send)
board.resumeAll.tip: Resume everything that stopped (send-back pending = resend held prompt / resumable = reconnect + continue / pending verify = start verify / orphaned waits = release / idle = start + resend held; needs-human excluded)
board.resumeAll.note: Resumes all stopped work at once
board.resumeAll.result: Send-backs: {reworked} / continued: {resumed} / verify started: {verify} / waits released: {released}
board.repoWait: Waiting for repo confirmation: candidate to switch → {slug}
settings.title: Settings
repo.gtip.owner: GitHub repositories with slug "{owner}/…" (from git remote or set at registration)
repo.gtip.user: GitHub-independent user repositories (.git-less dirs under workspace/repoScanDirs, .git dirs under the user dir/repoScanDirs)
repo.gtip.local: Repositories whose slug has no owner (unregistered IDE-managed dirs, ownerless slugs)
repo.regNote: slug is inferred from the git remote when omitted. Unregistered IDE-managed repos can also be added via "Add to watch list" on each card. Dirs without .git under the workspace and repos under the user directory or config.repoScanDirs are also detected as "user" (GitHub not required)
agent.label: Label
agent.regNote: Register an AI connection. type: acp=ACP-capable CLI / agent=Canvas-compatible /agent protocol (bridge-hub :8511, external agents) / openai=OpenAI-compatible API. The active agent handles new chats (existing chats keep their creation-time agent). token is saved to secrets.json tokens (never written to config)
sys.title: System
sys.restart.tip: Restart control (deferred until busy chats finish)
sys.restartForce.tip: Abort running/waiting chats and restart immediately
sys.restartNote: Deferred while busy/waiting chats remain. Force aborts running chats and restarts immediately
autostart.title: Auto-start
autostart.note: Registers KasugaiAgentDispatcher in the HKCU Run key so control stays resident at logon. While resident, the docs launch buttons always work
banner.pending: Restart of control deferred (waiting for running chats)…
confirm.restartForce: Abort running/waiting chats and restart control.mjs now. Continue?
confirm.restart:
Restart control.mjs?
It will be deferred until running chats finish
dirpick.notRestarted: control.mjs has not been restarted (use "Restart system" in Settings to update)
ref.head: References
edit.tip: Revise and resend (↑ recalls it too)
edit.label: ✎ Edit
board.verifyBack.tip: re-implementation sent back after a failed verify
prop.open.tip: Click to show details in the center pane
assets.title: Asset updates
assets.check.tip: Fetch CDN manifest and diff (auto-apply channels are applied too)
assets.rollbackConfirm: Rollback channel {ch} to the previous version?
assets.note: panel/docs updates apply on browser reload. Behavioral channels (prompts) go through proposals.
board.start.tip: Start via session/new (resends prompts held by a failed start)
sil.title: silences (filing mute)
sil.note: candidates matching the matchers (source/repo/kind, blank = any) are not filed for the duration; expires automatically
